tps.bug: Oversized SVG uploads go through the new ImageMagick downsize loop because SVG counts as an image, so the vector file is rasterized or corrupted in place before Upload.create_for parses it as SVG.
tps.evidenciaOpus: The new auto-downsize block (uploads_controller.rb:63-70) runs whenever FileHelper.is_image?(filename) matches, and FileHelper.images includes svg (file_helper.rb:31). An oversized SVG is therefore passed to ImageMagick convert -resize 80%> and overwritten in place, even though Upload.create_for handles SVGs separately via Nokogiri (upload.rb:63-66).
tps.evidenciaAstra: SVG is included in the image whitelist (lib/file_helper.rb:31), so the new loop rewrites oversized SVG uploads in place (app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb:64–67). That invokes ImageMagick’s raster resize pipeline (app/models/optimized_image.rb:126–133), which does not preserve the original vector content, before Upload.create_for parses the file as SVG (app/models/upload.rb:63–66). This introduces a bug for oversized SVG uploads.
